intro: Niagara Falls has plenty of tourist traps — and a handful of meals that are actually worth it. Some of these are about the view as much as the food.

picks.name: Skylon Tower Revolving Dining Room
picks.why: Dinner 236 m above the Falls as the room slowly rotates. Pricey, but an unforgettable view.

picks.name: Table Rock House Restaurant
picks.why: Right at the brink of the Horseshoe Falls — the closest dinner table to the water.

picks.name: Antica Pizzeria & Ristorante
picks.why: Wood-fired pizza and Italian classics away from the Clifton Hill crowds.

picks.name: Napoli Ristorante & Pizza
picks.why: Long-running family Italian spot that locals have been going to for years.

picks.name: Weinkeller
picks.why: Wine bar and restaurant pouring local Niagara wines alongside a seasonal menu.

picks.name: Koutouki
picks.why: Family-friendly Greek dinners with generous portions.
